record.paper_title: Some open problems on well-filtered spaces and sober spaces
record.original_question: If X is a co-sober T0 space, is its Smyth power space PS(X) again co-sober? Here co-sober means every k-irreducible nonempty compact saturated subset K of X is of the form up k for a unique point k, and PS(X) is the upper Vietoris space on K(X).

evidence.quote: Question 9.4. ([43]) Is the Smyth power space PS (X) of a co-sober space X again co-sober?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let X be a T0 topological space. A nonempty subset A of X is called irreducible if whenever A is contained in the union of two closed sets, it is contained in one of them. A subset is saturated if it equals the intersection of its open neighborhoods (equivalently, it is an upper set in the specialization order). Denote by K(X) the collection of all nonempty compact saturated subsets of X. For x in X, write ↑x for the saturation {y in X : x ≤ y in the specialization order}.

Call a nonempty compact saturated subset K of X k-irreducible if, whenever K = K1 ∪ K2 with K1, K2 nonempty compact saturated, then K = K1 or K = K2. The space X is called co-sober if every k-irreducible member of K(X) is of the form ↑x for a unique x in X.

The Smyth power space PS(X) is the set K(X) equipped with the upper Vietoris topology, generated by the sets ☐U := {K in K(X) : K ⊆ U} as U ranges over open subsets of X.

Question: If X is a co-sober T0 space, must its Smyth power space PS(X) again be co-sober?
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an open question in the literature on well-filtered and sober spaces. Recent work establishes related results (e.g., if PS(X) is co-sober then X is co-sober, and various sobriety/well-filteredness preservation theorems for Smyth power constructions), but the converse direction asked here does not appear to have been resolved in available sources.

status_evidence.snippet: Provides counterexamples and basic theory of co-sober spaces.
status_evidence.claim: Background on co-sober spaces; the Smyth power case is not settled here.

status_evidence.title: The answers to some questions on H-sober spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Recent paper addressing related H-sobriety questions about Smyth power spaces.
status_evidence.claim: Related questions on Smyth power spaces continue to be studied, but the specific co-sober preservation question remains open in accessible literature.
